action_and_domain.geometry: one-sided 4+1 Minkowski half-space y>=0 with one spacelike extra coordinate
action_and_domain.dynamics: autonomous quadratic scalar action; no new channel, interaction, time dependence or gravitational backreaction

scattering.unitarity: |R|^2=1 for all real p>0 with g nonzero
scattering.bare_resonance: D=0 exists above gap only if m^2>M^2; then R=-1,Q=2ip/g,Phi_0=0, all finite for fixed g nonzero
scattering.decoupled_limit: for fixed D nonzero, g->0 gives R0=(ip+c)/(ip-c),Q->0; g=0,D=0 is a separate free-oscillator degeneracy and not a value of the divided formula

packet_hypotheses.fixed_k: a(p) in C_c^infinity((p0,p1)),0<p0<p1<infinity, using the full incoming-plus-reflected continuum modes in theorem equation (13)
packet_hypotheses.bound_projection: zero coupled bound projection for both position and velocity; automatic for the exact continuum expansion, not implied by q=q_dot=0 at finite starting time
packet_hypotheses.finite_global_energy_version: a(k,p) smooth compact in k and p,|k|<=K and common p interval away from zero; Fourier fiber alone is not global brane energy
packet_hypotheses.quantum_version: coherent continuum displacement of full coupled ground state; bound occupation above ground-state baseline zero; connected covariance unchanged
packet_hypotheses.excluded_rate_claims: no uniform estimate as p0->0 or g->0, and no rapid-decay claim for nonsmooth/nonvanishing endpoint amplitudes

derived_results.temporary_storage: q and its bare energy can be nonzero during a pulse; stationary mean work into q is zero
derived_results.local_packet_decay: q,q_dot and fields/first derivatives on every bounded y interval are O(|t|^-N) for every N under the stated compact smooth support; quadratic local-energy majorant is O(|t|^-2N)
derived_results.asymptotic_energy: in the declared complex fiber norm, E_in=int dp omega^2|a|^2=E_out=int dp omega^2|aR|^2; global k packets integrate this relation over k
derived_results.bound_no_capture: continuum and bound spectral projections do not mix under the static self-adjoint linear evolution
derived_results.reflection_interference: direct Robin reflection and brane radiation must be combined coherently; radiation alone is not net absorption

decision_scope.established_conditionally: transient excitation followed by unit reflection and local decay for the declared continuum packet class
not_established: dynamical origin of incoming packet energy
permanent brane capture of a pure incoming continuum packet
exclusion of interacting, time-dependent or additional-channel HDBLAST models
decision_scope.four_dimensional_replica: accepted continuum-field representation reproduces the matched scattering preparation and brane observables
